_comment: Spirits Calling — ComfyUI generation table. Each entry becomes one PNG in RawAssets/AI/<category>/<name>.png. Civ tints are applied in-engine over the team color, so keep textures fairly NEUTRAL/GRAYSCALE-leaning with the pattern in the emissive/detail — the engine adds the hue. 'tileable' items must seamlessly tile.

defaults.negative: text, watermark, signature, logo, people, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, seam, border frame

items.name: East_pattern
items.prompt: seamless tileable ornamental texture, ancient East Asian cloud-and-thunder motif, flowing jade filigree, taoist talisman line-work, subtle emissive glyphs, dark stone base, high detail, orthographic flat pattern, game texture
